Recalled commitments carrying their values (title or due)
Reasons and task titles in the owner's language and script (P2-O11)

notes: Pre-screen only until the owner confirms the bursts' labels (PRD R2 #5): the gate counts owner-confirmed bursts (`confirmed_items` = burst ids) and needs the whole set.
